summary: Python terminal wrapper for legacy exact-cover plan; required args: repository root, plan directory, output path; reads implementation contract and command registry JSON; runs terminal validation subprocess from repository root; validates all slice red/green command IDs against registry; failures: validation nonzero or registry drift; emits quick-dev implementation-complete.v1 result with plan ID, contract/registry hashes, terminal command ID, validated IDs, failure list, authorization, lifecycle none, stdout hash; pass authorizes implementation-complete; pass publishes canonical receipt under repair/round-1, conflict gets hash-suffixed successor; writes output JSON and prints compact result; exits 0 on pass, 1 on failure; receipt writes are idempotent and conflicting existing content raises error
